description: The Project 1 wind turbines shall have a maximum hub height of 522 feet (159 meters) above mean sea level and a maximum blade tip height of 932 feet (284 meters) above mean sea level.
context_quote: The Preferred Alternative would ... restrict the height of WTGs in Project 1 to a maximum hub height of 522 ft (159 m) AMSL and maximum blade tip height of 932 ft (284 m) AMSL.

description: The total number of permanent structures (WTGs, OSSs, and/or met tower) constructed for the Project shall not exceed 197.
context_quote: The total number of permanent structures constructed (WTGs, OSSs, and/or met tower) may not exceed 197.

description: The wind turbines shall be arranged in a uniform grid pattern with rows oriented east-northeast to west-southwest spaced 1.0 nautical mile (1.9 kilometers) apart and rows oriented north to south spaced 0.6 nautical mile (1.1 kilometers) apart.
context_quote: However, modifications would be made to the wind turbine array layout to require the proposed OSSs, met tower, and WTGs to be aligned in a uniform grid with rows in an east-northeast to west-southwest direction spaced 1.0 nautical mile (nmi) (1.0 km) apart and rows in an approximately north to south direction spaced 0.6 nmi (1.1 km) apart.

description: Up to 29 wind turbines, 1 offshore substation, and associated inter-array cables shall be microsited outside of the 1,000-foot (305-meter) buffer of the ridge and swale features within the NMFS-identified Areas of Concern 1 and 2.
context_quote: microsite up to 29 WTGs, 1 OSS, and associated interarray cables outside of the 1,000 foot (305-meter) buffer of the ridge and swale features within the NMFS-identified AOC 1 and AOC 2

description: A single wind turbine shall be removed from a location approximately 150 to 200 feet (45.8 to 61 meters) from the observed Fish Haven (Atlantic City Artificial Reef Site).
geographic_scope: Vicinity of the Fish Haven (Atlantic City Artificial Reef Site)
context_quote: and the removal of a single turbine approximately 150 to 200 ft (45.8 to 61 m) from the observed Fish Haven (Atlantic City Artificial Reef Site)

description: The Project shall include up to 383 nautical miles (710 kilometers) of submarine export cables, consisting of up to two routes to New Jersey.
context_quote: As proposed in the COP, the two Projects will include up to 383 nm (710 km) of submarine export cables, consisting of up to two routes to New Jersey.

description: The Project 1 export cable will interconnect in Atlantic City, New Jersey, and the Project 2 export cable will interconnect in Sea Girt, Monmouth County, New Jersey.
context_quote: The COP further proposes that the Project 1 export cable will interconnect in Atlantic City, New Jersey, and the Project 2 export cable will interconnect in Sea Girt, Monmouth County, New Jersey.

description: A minimum 0.81-nautical mile (1,500-meter) setback shall be provided between the wind turbines in the Atlantic Shores South Lease Area (OCS-A 0499) and the wind turbines in the Ocean Wind 1 Lease Area (OCS-A 0498).
geographic_scope: Boundary between Atlantic Shores South and Ocean Wind 1 Lease Areas
context_quote: and provide a minimum 0.81-nautical mile (1,500-meter) setback between the WTGs in Atlantic Shores South and the WTGs in Ocean Wind 1 (Lease Area OCS-A 0498) by removing two WTGs and micrositing one WTG from Project 1.
